job.title: Team Member
description: Join the Sunbelt Express Car Wash family!

We're a locally owned express car wash with 6 locations around Charlotte, and we're growing. Our team members keep the wash running smoothly and make every customer's visit a good one. We care about our people, our community and a really clean car.
- A fun, friendly team that has each other's back
- Room to grow — most of our site managers started as team members
Starting pay is $14 – $16 per hour. We have openings at our Plaza Midwood, South End and University City locations.
Sound like you? Apply today and our hiring team will reach out within a few days. We can't wait to meet you!
